bulletins.a_little_laugh:
**"Nobody prepares you for the part of your 50s where you're simultaneously trying to build muscle, lose fat, protect your knees, fix your hormones, eat 150g of protein, and remember why you walked into the kitchen. But here we are. Thriving-ish."**

---

**Why did the cookie go to the nurse?** *Because it felt crumby.*

---

**Why did the student eat his homework?** *Because the teacher said it was a piece of cake.*

---

**Before Mass a young boy asked his mom what the red light was under the Crucifix. She explained that it was the Tabernacle Light which burns day and night indicating the Presence of The Lord in the Blessed Sacrament.** *When praying after Mass the young boy whispers to his mom, "Do we have to stay until the red light turns green?"*
